map.圆度误差（本页代码口径）：圆度误差=最大半径−最小半径（mm）；联动量：圆度误差: Roundness error (this page's code basis): roundness error = maximum radius − minimum radius (mm); linked values: roundness error (μm) = error×1000, mean radius = (maximum radius + minimum radius) ÷ 2 (mm), relative roundness = error ÷ (mean radius||1) × 10⁶ (ppm, with the mean radius falling back to 1 when 0). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; the error and ppm value grow linearly with the difference between the two radii, and the ppm basis, independent of absolute radius size, makes parts easy to compare.
